videoLab.title: Multi-product video recognition lab
videoLab.subtitle: No sign-in is needed in local development; administrators only in other environments. The uploaded video and temporary frames are processed for this request and deleted afterward; results are not added to customer records or production. Local recognition uses Codex CLI on sampled frames; cloud recognition uses the OpenAI API and may also send available audio for transcription.
videoLab.videoHelp: Select several at once or add them one by one. Each clip can be up to 3 minutes and 250 MB; clips are analyzed in order, and one failure will not stop the others.
videoLab.chooseVideoHelp: Choose MP4, MOV, or WebM; up to 250 MB per clip.
videoLab.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: Black Friday promotion, refrigerators and washers
videoLab.unverifiedHint: This is only a clue. The system reviews the visuals independently and does not treat the description as product fact.
videoLab.factsLabel: Customer-provided product list, menu, or price list (optional)
videoLab.factsPlaceholder: Paste customer-confirmed product names, models, or price information. Do not add guesses.
videoLab.factsHelp: Used to check single-product content. Prices, models, stock, and offers still need customer-confirmed facts.
videoLab.processingHint: After each video is recognized, one optimized image is generated for its main product. Keep this page open; temporary video and audio files are deleted when processing finishes.
videoLab.codexPlanUsage: Uses your Codex account plan; no per-call API estimate
videoLab.candidateNextStep: The main product image is generated automatically after recognition. Use the button to generate images for other candidates as needed.
videoLab.candidateProminence: Suitable for an individual post: {prominent} · Samples used: {frames}
videoLab.noCandidates: There is not enough evidence to group separate product candidates.
videoLab.opportunitiesHelp: What kind of post or video could be made from this clip.
videoLab.relationshipsHelp: How the listed products connect to each other or to the promotion.
videoLab.noRelationships: No clear bundle or promotion relationships were found.
videoLab.unverifiedHelp: On-screen text and speech are clues only. Do not publish them as facts about price, model, stock, or offers without customer confirmation.
videoLab.noAudio: This video has no audio track, so speech transcription was skipped.
videoLab.localTranscriptSkipped: Speech transcription is skipped in local Codex mode; recognition is based on video frames.
videoLab.needsProductList: Needs a customer product list for matching
